common.notFound: We could not find that on this phone.
demo.banner: Demo: an invented school and invented children. Your own data is not touched.
home.title: Your classes
home.emptyBody: Add your class and its students. Then make a test and tap through answers for the whole class.
home.privacy: Everything you enter stays on this phone. There is no account and no server that receives it.
class.label: Class {grade} {section}
class.noTestsBody: Make a test or a rubric to start marking.
class.noStudentsBody: Add your students first: import a list, paste from a spreadsheet, or type names in.
newClass.title: Add a class
newClass.needGrade: Please write the class or grade.
roster.title: Students
roster.importBody: Choose a CSV file, or copy the roll number and name columns from a spreadsheet and paste them below.
roster.problem.dupRoll: this roll number is already used
roster.problem.tooLong: too long to be a name or roll number
roster.keptAnyway: kept, in case two children share a name
roster.alreadyHave: Roll {roll} ({name}) is already in this class
roster.name: Name
roster.leftHint: A student who left keeps their old results but is not shown when you mark new tests.
newTest.title: New test
newTest.keyBody: Questions with answers A to D, or right and wrong.
newTest.rubricBody: Criteria with levels, for reading, writing, speaking or projects.
newTest.examplesNote: These are examples to show how it works, not official curricula or tests.
newTest.notJson: That file is not a template (it should be a .json file).
newTest.name: Name of the test
newTest.subject: Subject
newTest.keyHint: Tap the right answer; it moves to the next question by itself.
newTest.domainHint: A skill you type is copied to the questions below it that have none, so you only type it where it changes.
newTest.rubricHint: You can describe each level later by sharing the rubric as a template file.
newTest.needKeys: Please fill in the answer for every question.
newTest.needCriteria: Please name at least one criterion.
entry.question: Question {q} of {n}
entry.saved: Each tap is saved on this phone as you go.
grid.hint: Tap any box to change it.
grid.caption: Marks for {title}
results.basis: Based on {n} students with every answer marked. {absent} absent and {open} not finished are left out, not counted as zero.
results.noneBody: Results appear when at least one student has every answer marked.
results.commonWrong: A common wrong answer may point to a misunderstanding:
results.groupsNote: Students ranked by score and split into four groups. Equal scores are always in the same group.
results.helpNone: No student is below half in any skill.
progress.averageChart: Line chart of the class average in each test
student.subject: Subject
student.domainsNote: All finished tests in this subject, added up by skill.
report.printHint: In the print screen, choose “Save as PDF” to keep a file or share it.
report.footer: Made with {product} on the teacher's phone.
csv.name: Name
settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: {product} is free and open source. It has no account, no tracking and no server for your data.
backup.title: Back up
backup.body: Make a locked backup file to keep safe or to move to a new phone. Send it to yourself on WhatsApp, or save it to Drive.
backup.passphraseIntro: Choose a passphrase. The file is locked with it, so only someone who knows it can open the file.
backup.warn: Write the passphrase down. Without it the backup cannot be opened, by you or by us.
backup.failed: The backup could not be made. Nothing was changed.
restore.title: Restore or combine
restore.body: Open a backup from this or another phone. Classes already here are updated; other classes are added beside them, so a head teacher can combine several teachers' files.
restore.contains: This backup holds {classes} classes, {students} students and {tests} tests, made on {date}.
restore.mergeNote: Nothing on this phone is deleted. Where both have a mark for the same answer, the newer one is kept.
restore.error.wrong-passphrase: That passphrase does not open this file.
restore.error.not-a-backup: This is not a backup file.
restore.error.newer-version: This backup was made by a newer version. Update the app and try again.
restore.error.damaged: The file seems damaged and could not be read.
pin.title: Locked
pin.forgot: Forgot it? Restore your last backup on a fresh install.
pin.settingsBody: For shared phones: ask for a PIN when the app opens. It keeps others out of the app; it does not encrypt what is stored on the phone.
danger.title: Delete everything
danger.body: Removes every class, student and mark from this phone. Backups you have shared are not affected.
danger.confirm: This cannot be undone. Type {word} to confirm.
